description_en: Invoke the ListIoTCloudConnectorEIPs API to query the list of Elastic IP Addresses (EIPs) associated with a cloud connector instance
description_zh: 调用ListIoTCloudConnectorEIPs接口查询云连接器实例关联的弹性公网IP列表
kebab_example: aliyun iotcc list-iot-cloud-connector-eips --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --iot-cloud-connector-id iotcc-bp1odcab8tmno0hdq0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListIoTCloudConnectorEIPs

parameters.help_en:
Indicates whether a token for the next query exists. Valid values:
Do not specify this parameter for the first query or when there is no subsequent query.
If there is a subsequent query, set this parameter to the NextToken value returned by the previous API call
parameters.help_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：
第一次查询和没有下一次查询时，均无需填写。
如果有下一次查询，取值为上一次API调用返回的NextToken值
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The number of entries returned per page when querying results in batches. Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 20
parameters.help_zh: 分批次查询时每次显示的条目数。取值范围：1~100，默认值为20
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the cloud connector instance.

You can obtain the region ID by invoking the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/313836.html API
parameters.help_zh:
云连接器实例所在的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/313836.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

items.description_en:
The list of associated Elastic IP Addresses (EIPs).

The value can be a JSON array consisting of multiple IP addresses separated by commas (,).

Only cloud connector instances of the Basic Edition support returning a list of associated Elastic IP Addresses (EIPs)
items.description_zh:
关联的弹性公网IP列表。

取值可以由多个IP组成一个JSON数组，IP之间用半角逗号（,）隔开。

只有基础版的云连接器实例支持返回关联的弹性公网IP列表

MaxResults.description_en: The number of entries returned per page when querying results in batches. Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 20
MaxResults.description_zh: 分批次查询时每次显示的条目数。取值范围：1~100，默认值为20

NextToken.description_en:
Indicates whether a token for the next query exists. Valid values:
If NextToken is empty, there is no subsequent query.
If NextToken has a return value, this value represents the token to start the next query
NextToken.description_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：
如果NextToken为空表示没有下一次查询。
如果NextToken有返回值，该取值表示下一次查询开始的令牌

TotalCount.description_en: The number of entries in the list
